thread:
viv: I published the RCA for this morning's control-plane cert rotation fallout. Internal doc: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.com/pm/1887654321 (internal only).
postmortem-bot: Postmortem uploaded and indexed. Timeline, impact, root cause, and mitigation sections populated. :robot_face:
marco: TL;DR: an intermediate cert expired during a staggered rotation. A subset of control-plane nodes failed health checks, triggering a fallback to older proxies which increased request latency and retries for ~12 minutes. No customer data exposure.
director-ops: Please add a one-paragraph executive summary and a short slide for SLT. Also copy top action items here so leadership can scan quickly.
viv: Pasting the immediate actions from the doc. Owners, short ETAs. ACK in thread and update the doc with ETAs.
```
- TASK-01 | Owner: marco        | Rotate the full cert chain and validate trust path across regions | Due: 2026-03-30
- TASK-02 | Owner: ops          | Add a 30-day cert-expiry alert and an automated weekly expiry report | Due: 2026-03-28
- TASK-03 | Owner: ops          | Automate cert rotation in CI/CD with a canary and rollback path | Due: 2026-04-05
- TASK-04 | Owner: qa           | Add e2e smoke test that verifies cert chain and proxy health during deploys | Due: 2026-04-02
- TASK-05 | Owner: cs           | Draft a short, non-technical customer advisory template for ops to use | Due: 2026-03-29
- CHECKPOINT | All owners        | Post a short status update in the doc by EOD 2026-03-27
```
marco: Ive rotated the chain in prod regions A/B/C; posting rollout notes and verification logs in the doc. PR for automation scaffold: https://github.com/redwood/control-plane/pull/7202 :white_check_mark:
ops: Will add the 30-day alert and weekly report. I'll test alerts in staging today and tag oncall when enabled.
qa: Will add the e2e cert smoke as a pre-deploy gate. ETA for PR is 48h.
cs: Drafting the advisory now; will keep it brief and non-technical. Will ask legal to review before sending to impacted customers.
postmortem-bot: Follow-up checkpoint scheduled: 2026-04-11 14:00 PT. Calendar invite and agenda added to the doc. :calendar:
director-ops: Good containment. Please ensure the automation PR includes an emergency rollback runbook and a checklist for manual rotation if CI fails.
viv: Noted. I added the rollback runbook section in the doc and linked the emergency keys/contacts. Please ACK the doc and your tasks. If you cant make the April 11 checkpoint, leave a short written update in the doc beforehand. Well treat that meeting as the closure checkpoint for this RCA. :white_check_mark:
